description: This file defines the ServiceDiscoveryClient class, which is a client for interacting with AWS's Amazon Route 53 Auto Naming service. It provides method annotations for various API operations such as creating, deleting, and updating DNS namespaces and services, as well as discovering instances and related actions.

classes.name: ServiceDiscoveryClient
classes.description: A client class for AWS ServiceDiscovery, extending AwsClient, providing methods for interacting with Amazon Route 53 Auto Naming service.

methods.name: createHttpNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new HTTP namespace in Route 53 auto-naming.

methods.name: createPrivateDnsNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new private DNS namespace.

methods.name: createPublicDnsNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new public DNS namespace.

methods.name: createService
methods.description: Creates a new service within a namespace.

methods.name: deleteServiceAttributes
methods.description: Deletes attributes associated with a service.

methods.name: discoverInstances
methods.description: Discovers instances associated with a service.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific instance.

methods.name: getInstancesHealthStatus
methods.description: Gets the health status of instances.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags attached to a resource.

methods.name: updateInstanceCustomHealthStatus
methods.description: Updates custom health status for an instance.
